deskyard share list: list a computer's shares

Usage: deskyard [-c COMPUTER] share list COMPUTER [--json]

Lists the shares of a computer: who it was shared with and by, at which level,
until when, and whether they are connected now. Needs full access to it.

Arguments:
  COMPUTER   string      required  computer name

Options:
  --json               print JSON instead of text
  --server NAME        the server to manage (see `deskyard server list`);
                       default: the server -c SERVER/COMPUTER names, else the
                       default server

Prints: a table NAME LEVEL SHARED-BY EXPIRES LAST-USED NOTE; with --json the
  API's [Share]

Examples:
  deskyard share list alice

Where: on this machine, talking to the server
Exit codes: 0 ok, 1 error, 2 usage error; the server's refusal (403 for what your account may not do) is an error
